metadata.title: तिपरासा के लिए करो या मरो की स्थिति - प्रद्योत किशोर माणिक्य | Tribals must fight - Pradyut Kishore
metadata.description: Pradyut Kishor Manikya, the leader of Tipra Motha in Tripura, has urged the tribal population to pursue peaceful demonstrations to assert their rights. He acknowledged the central government's willingness to address tribal community demands but highlighted obstacles from authorities in Agartala. Manikya emphasized the importance of public pressure to secure tribal rights. He also cautioned that after delimitation, the tribal voice could weaken, making this a crucial time for the tribal community to assert its demands through agitation.
